newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says suffering damages from truckers' strike.
newsitem.headline: Spain says suffering damages from truckers' strike.

text.p: Spanish Development Minister Rafael Arias Salgado said on Friday that Spain will guarantee unimpeded travel on its roads despite a truckers' strike which was imposing grave damages on the economy.

"This action is conducted by a radical minority which is aiming to harm the national economy...I want to say the government will guarantee unimpeded travel on Spanish road," said Salgado speaking to the weekly cabinet meeting.
He said also that the Spanish economy was suffering grave damages from the nine-day-old strike.
